name: The Silent Church
summary: The Man in Marble will shelter anyone brought to him, and asked us to bring some before the parade.

stages.journal: The Man in Marble can shelter villagers from the festival's compulsion, but only those brought through his door, and he cannot leave the church to fetch them.
objectives: Bring three villagers to the church
stages.hint: Bring at least three freed or compelled villagers to the Silent Church.

stages.journal: Three villagers sit in the pews, quiet, while the carnival rages outside. The parade will press on the door.
stages.hint: Be at the church door when the parade begins.

stages.journal: The door held. The Man in Marble watched the crowd break on it and said nothing, which from him was thanks.
We let the Man in Marble bar the door. Those we had not brought in are with the parade now.
